What is a Project Dashboard?

A project dashboard is a visual representation of your projects, providing real-time insights into progress, deadlines, and key performance indicators (KPIs). It's a single platform where you can track everything from client communication to team assignments, ensuring that every project stays on track. By using Base44 to build your project dashboard, you can:
